decisions.reason: Its move from a simple mention to a dedicated page suggests growing commitment, and as an identity-integration service close to the core offer it still has option value despite some overlap risk with other access products.

It remains only lightly commercialized on the website, but as an open GIS framework that fits the firm's platform-oriented, standards-linked strategy it is still worth keeping while the cost of maintaining the option appears limited.

This product has a clear dedicated positioning in 2024 and directly supports the firm's strategic goal of embedding GeoIT in existing enterprise user-management environments, so its prospects look strong.
As a newly launched workshop rooted in the established consulting business, it is inexpensive to keep on offer and should be retained until more demand information is revealed.
